decisions.display_source: Unchanged raw master with display-only white/cyan matte and nearest alpha; never game payload.
decisions.reason: Actual exact original and unchanged raw master compared on both alpha comparison pages and native source board. The repaired return still uses two neat large gold diamonds in a horizontal row on each collar panel. The exact original green panels instead contain their own irregular multiple-small yellow/green light-mark layout. Copy the actual original mark footprints, relative positions, spacing and yellow/green colour without replacing them with a guessed pair of large diamonds or named rank. The visible green background panel must remain green. Keep all unrelated hair, smooth face, cap, clothing, fitted broad short collar, opaque card/photo interior, crop and actual exterior transparency. Do not infer a rank or symbol from the name or uniform.
